## RepoForge template contract

Check the items that apply:

- [ ] Minimal / Standard / Full remain independent artifacts.
- [ ] Full does not invent capabilities or infrastructure the target project does not have.

- [ ] Stress coverage was updated when a new edge case or semantic boundary was introduced.
